title: In 2024, Pennsylvania couple bought 101 acres; by 2026 all were protected

The easement was finalised in August 2026, permanently protecting all 101 acres for future generations.

title: Extra CO2 boosted Wisconsin forest productivity 39%, but ozone cut the gain
content: A Wisconsin experiment studied forest communities exposed to high carbon dioxide and ozone. Elevated carbon dioxide significantly increased forest productivity and carbon storage over eleven years. Conversely, increased ozone levels reduced forest productivity and ecosystem carbon content. The combined effects showed carbon dioxide stimulating growth and ozone limiting it. These findings highlight forests' complex responses to atmospheric changes.

title: Mark Zuckerberg owns 'Doomsday bunker' in Hawaii, waterfront mansion in Miami and more

title: Cleveland's 1933 bridge closes immediately after deeper beam damage is found

title: Why some people constantly check their phones even when they are not bored
content: Smartphones bring us immediate engagement, filling the gaps of silence and curtailing our tendency to reflect. This urge to stay connected often arises from our discomfort with unplanned time and our inner dialogues. Studies indicate this behavior correlates with a heightened susceptibility to boredom and a yearning for connections. The feeling of loneliness and learned patterns also heavily influence our habitual phone usage.

title: Ken Kesey's psychedelic Furthur bus returns to San Francisco for restoration

title: In 2020, CalGuard crews rescued 242 people trapped by California's Creek Fire

California has since expanded its nighttime aviation capabilities and interagency training.

content: the PSLV remains the backbone of the country's launch programme, notwithstanding its recent failures . GSLV-Mk2 gave India the ability to put heavier satellites into geostationary transfer orbit . LVM-3 has expanded India’s reach further . SSLV is being positioned as a quicker route to orbit for smaller satellites, beyond them lie upgrades, reusable launch technologies and the Next Generation Launch Vehicle .

title: Own a piece of Venice: Private island with Napoleonic fort up for $7.5 m
content: a private island in the Venetian Lagoon, complete with its own historic Napoleonic fort, has gone on the market for $7.5 million . the island of Crevan, spanning around 5,700 square metres, features a 215-square-metre fortress that has been transformed into a small villa .

title: 11 killed, seven injured as fuel tanker crashes, explodes in western Iran
content: the tanker hit several other vehicles before bursting into flames near a traffic police station close to the city of Sanandaj . the injured were taken to nearby hospitals for treatment, AP cites . similar accident killed 15 in 2018 .

title: Seattle light rail linked to deaths of 2,000 fish in Lake Washington
content: 2,000 fish have been found dead near electrical cables and equipment that hang beneath the bridge into the lake . the deaths have raised concerns among biologists, regulators and local residents about how transit infrastructure interacts with one of the region’s most important bodies of water .
